events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, screenwriter, and producer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From 'Monty Python' to 'Fawlty Towers', his unique brand of humour has kept us laughing for decades. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968, making it 58 years since its release this month.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: It's 58 years since The Beatles dropped 'The White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece that broke all the rules. What's your go-to track from this legendary double LP?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 years old.

angles.name: Freddie Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury today. His voice, his stage presence, his legacy. Forever a champion. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on December 3, 1965, marking 61 years since its debut.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Legacy
angles.copy: 61 years ago today, The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that pushed boundaries and influenced countless artists. What's your favourite track from it?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the tragic passing of music icon John Lennon, who would have been 86 years old.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary John Lennon today. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's the Lennon song that means the most to you?

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Music legend David Bowie, born on January 8, 1947, would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie at 80
angles.copy: The Starman would have been 80 today. Celebrating the incredible artistry and enduring legacy of David Bowie. What's your favourite Bowie era?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, born on January 8, 1935, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: The King's Birthday
angles.copy: Long live the King! Elvis Presley would have been 92 today. His music still shakes, rattles, and rolls us. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page, born on January 9, 1944, celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the iconic Jimmy Page! The architect of Led Zeppelin's sound and one of rock's greatest guitarists. What's your favourite Page riff?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Sir Rod Stewart, the distinctive raspy-voiced singer-songwriter born on January 10, 1945, celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod The Mod
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the legendary Rod Stewart! From rock anthems to timeless ballads, his voice is unmistakable. What's your favourite Rod song?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the lead singer of Madness, born on January 13, 1961, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Madness Frontman
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the Nutty Boy himself, Suggs! The frontman of Madness, who's given us so many unforgettable tunes. What's your favourite Madness hit?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English singer Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)', born on January 17, 1956, celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Soul Boy
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to the wonderful Paul Young! His smooth vocals defined a generation. What's your favourite Paul Young classic?

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The legendary country music icon Dolly Parton, born on January 19, 1946, celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Queen of Country
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton! A true superstar, songwriter, and philanthropist. What's your favourite Dolly moment or song?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman, singer-songwriter, and television personality Gary Barlow, born on January 20, 1971, celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That Icon
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow! From pop anthems to West End hits, he's a true musical talent. What's your favourite Gary Barlow song, solo or with the band?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his string of R&B and pop hits, born on January 21, 1950, celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the incredible Billy Ocean! His voice is pure sunshine. What's your favourite track to get you in a 'Caribbean Queen' mood?

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame first induction anniversary
events.blurb: The first ever induction ceremony for the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame was held on January 23, 1986, honouring legends like Elvis Presley and Chuck Berry.

angles.name: Hall of Fame Beginnings
angles.copy: On this day in 1986, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its first induction ceremony. Who do you think was the most deserving of that inaugural class?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen, born on January 27, 1972, celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That Star
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to the charming Mark Owen! From boyband heartthrob to solo artist, he's still got it. What's your favourite Mark Owen moment?

events.title: The Beatles' rooftop concert anniversary
events.blurb: On January 30, 1969, The Beatles performed their legendary final public concert on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London.

angles.name: Rooftop Rockers
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles made history with their iconic rooftop concert in London. What a way to go out! Which track from that legendary set is your favourite?

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: English drummer, singer, songwriter, and record producer Phil Collins, born on January 30, 1951, celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: In The Air Tonight
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the legendary Phil Collins! From Genesis to solo superstardom, his hits are timeless. What's your favourite Phil Collins track?

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Hugh Grant, known for his roles in romantic comedies and dramas, born on September 9, 1960, celebrates his 67th birthday.

angles.name: British Charm
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday to the ever-charming Hugh Grant! From 'Four Weddings' to 'Notting Hill', he's graced our screens for decades. What's your favourite Hugh Grant film?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46

angles.name: Prince of Pop
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! From NSYNC to solo superstardom, he's a true entertainer. What's your favourite JT song?

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary English actor Sir David Jason, known for iconic roles like Del Boy and Jack Frost, born on February 2, 1940, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Lovely Jubbly
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason! From Peckham to Aidensfield, his characters are etched in our hearts. What's your favourite David Jason role?

events.title: The Day The Music Died anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks 68 years since 'The Day The Music Died' in 1959, when Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash.

angles.name: Remembering Legends
angles.copy: On this day in 1959, we lost Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper in 'The Day The Music Died'. Their impact on rock and roll is immeasurable. We remember them and their timeless music.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: English singer, songwriter, and musician Rick Astley, known for his 80s hits and recent resurgence, born on February 6, 1966, celebrates his 61st birthday today.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give You Up
angles.copy: Happy 61st birthday to the legend that is Rick Astley! From 80s icon to internet phenomenon, he's always entertaining. What's your favourite Rick Astley track?

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82

angles.name: Legend of Reggae
angles.copy: The King of Reggae, Bob Marley, would have been 82 today. His music brought messages of peace, love, and unity to the world. What's your favourite Bob Marley song?
